interpretation: Include first-window position as well as width and before/after gap. GirReborn18 versus Vesper34 is a nominal state-coordinate lead comparison, not prior dodge-to-parry elapsed time.
Manato Attack_10 has constant width30 and gaps20/40/66; supports testing timing context rather than width alone. Other inspected sequences have larger aid gaps99/69, so no boss-wide short-gap claim.
Jane short special gates0-9/0-10 coincide with state coordinate zero; investigate transition/lead context before attributing an intrinsically stricter per-boss rule.
Intervening attack events occur inside aid-window gaps; those gaps are not necessarily rest/recovery time.
Different state origins are not subtracted to fabricate sequence gaps; transition offsets, paths and dynamic timing remain unmeasured.

qteCommonReview.decision: Control Skills share final-hit Perfect Dodge / Evasive Assist -> realtime QTE. This is a resolved common rule, not a pending per-boss question.

Added the Graymane QTE manager from the same bundle. Reused three preserved Vesper managers whose current-source equivalence was previously verified. No game input.
